description: List API operation services, list operations for a service, or fetch one operation's coverage detail. No identity args: configured OpenAPI root file paths + operation counts. rootFilePath / serviceKey: operations with covering-test previews, coverageSummary, obsMappingState, and runtimeObservation (requestCount/rpm, errorRate, p50/p95/p99LatencyMs). Missing observability is unknown, not zero. id (ULID), or oasOperationId, or httpMethod+pathTemplate: request/query/response fields, response codes, covering tests. Prefer --id for detail and --root-file-path for a service list.
name: get-api-operations
title: Get API Operations
